title: FBI's National Crime Information Center reported hacked, CNN says
date_note: Date of the CNN report as relayed by Arab News (published 21 November, says CNN reported on Friday); the date of the intrusion is not stated.
place: Washington, DC, United States (FBI headquarters; location of the system not stated)
summary: Arab News reports that CNN said on Friday the FBI's National Crime Information Center was subject to an apparent breach by hackers, the second time in recent months. CNN cited two people briefed on an investigation into the incident. The article names no attacker, does not say what data was accessed and includes no FBI statement.
plain: A news report says hackers apparently broke into the FBI's national criminal information database. What was taken has not been reported.
exec: An apparent breach of a core US law-enforcement database is reported, second in recent months; details and FBI confirmation are not yet public.

validation.note: Single short Arab News article relaying CNN's report from two unnamed sources; the CNN original and any FBI statement were not read.
